object_description: four compact buildings of different sizes freely grouped under a mighty exposed concrete roof
geometry_property: three lengthways and one across the slope
openings of different widths between the volumes
design_condition: four buildings stand three lengthways and one across the sloping terrain in a freely chosen arrangement, with a roof spanning the gap between them to form the central nucleus of the school

positive: Four compact buildings form an interesting school cluster in a relatively intuitive free arrangement
A mighty exposed concrete roof spans the gap and becomes the actual nucleus of the school
Three square skylight openings bring enough light into the centre
A stately fountain underlines the importance of the central square
Openings of different widths between the volumes allow well-functioning neighbourhood networking
They give convincing access to the primary school
They act as viewing windows offering beautiful focused views of the landscape
The two sports fields are installed as inconspicuous inlays on an existing lower plateau
The geometric ordering structure of the complex is continued for the fields
The typology of the school buildings is simple
Fundamentality, clarity, manageability and orientation of the plans correspond to the urban disposition
The spatial proportions and the lighting are balanced
The vertical organisation cleverly develops from the topographical conditions
The first basement can be optimally lit on the slope side and used for school purposes
The mountain side holds rooms requiring less exposure
The different purposes are assigned to the four buildings in a functionally meaningful way
The proposed structure of all buildings makes sense, is economical and flexible enough in use
A simple architecture combining masonry and exposed concrete finds tectonic and tactile qualities
A very interesting and independent contribution with strengths in the conceptual approach and architectural attitude
negative: The aisle widths in the vertical access area are too narrow
The four buildings with the basement provoke a very high level of surface development
The sustainability target values are not fulfilled despite the compactness of the individual volumes
The creation costs are slightly above the target
